title: Digital Photography
description: Learn photography fundamentals including camera settings, composition, lighting, and photo editing.

modules.title: Module 1: Foundations
modules.summary: Learn the essentials of module 1 for Digital Photography.

content.text: In this lesson you'll learn about Creative Process and how to apply it in real-world scenarios within the context of Digital Photography.
Core Concept: Creative Process
This lesson covers the fundamentals of Creative Process. You'll learn practical techniques you can apply immediately in your digital photography projects.

content.title: Pro Tip
content.text: Practice Creative Process with real examples before moving to the next lesson.

content.title: Common Mistake
content.text: Beginners often rush through Creative Process without mastering the fundamentals. Take your time and build a solid foundation.

content.question: What is the main goal of learning Creative Process in Digital Photography?
content.explanation: The goal is to build a solid foundation in Creative Process that you can build on.

content.text: Apply it
Try applying Creative Process to a small project this week. Reflect on what worked and what needs more practice.
